geometry.blender_unit_settings: Metric with millimetre display; 1 Blender unit = 1 metre

limits: The STEP is a complete mechanical-arm reference, not a finished panda or human head enclosure.
The Blender head reference contains ten selected major meshes and omits some structural parts and fasteners.
The partial-reference height is not the verified total height of the commercial pan-tilt product.
The arrow view illustrates geometric cylinder centre lines and does not validate joint constraints or motion.
No enclosure model, printable shell, print profile, or mechanical fit verification is included.

source_context.pan_tilt_series: The material provider confirmed that the mechanical-arm base corresponds to the supplied two-axis pan-tilt product series.
source_context.specific_variant: D-type is a visual comparison candidate; exact dimensions, variant and actuator remain unverified.
